sources.entry: Conduck - Native voice and text client for your self-hosted or BYO-key AI, with a menu bar companion, global hotkey and Screenshot & Ask. Same conversation on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and CarPlay.

summary.one_liner: Conduck is an open-source (Apache-2.0) native Apple client that connects your devices to an AI you choose, such as your own server, a local model, or OpenRouter, with no Conduck server in between.
summary.what_it_does: Conduck is a client app that talks directly to a model endpoint or agent gateway you configure, using your own keys; the README states there is no model and no Conduck account or server in the path. It supports voice and text chat, with on-device dictation on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and attachments of photos and files. Chats sync across devices through private iCloud (CloudKit), with API keys and tokens stored in Keychain. The README describes a menu bar companion on Mac, a hotkey, Screenshot & Ask on Mac, Action Button and Shortcuts entry points, and Apple Watch and CarPlay access (CarPlay runs through the iPhone app). It also describes a Work area for organizing notes, screenshots and files per project, and per-model usage stats measured on-device. Setup paths named are OpenRouter sign-in, Ollama, LM Studio or other OpenAI-compatible servers, and agent gateways such as OpenClaw or Hermes via conduck-connect.
use_cases: chat with a self-hosted or local AI model from an iPhone or Mac
use OpenRouter models from Apple devices without an account
voice dictation and text chat with an AI on Apple devices
screenshot and ask an AI question from the Mac menu bar
continue the same AI conversation across Mac, iPhone and Apple Watch
pair a personal AI agent with tools and file sharing
how_to_run: Open Conduck/Conduck.xcodeproj in Xcode 26.5 or later.
Build and run. Simulator builds need no configuration.
Note: an unsigned simulator build cannot save keys, so added gateways will not persist; see QA mode or building for your own devices in the README.
stack: Swift (implied by native Apple app; not named in README)
notable: No Conduck-operated server or account; requests go directly from the device to the chosen AI
Same conversation syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and CarPlay via private iCloud
Official app and self-built versions share the same source; CarPlay is only in the official build
Contributions use Developer Certificate of Origin rather than a CLA
caveats: Requires iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS 26.5 or later; the Mac app needs Apple silicon
Self-built versions do not include CarPlay, which needs Apple's per-team entitlement
Official app terms: individuals only; organizations need a separate agreement; the Conduck name and duck artwork are trademarked and excluded from the Apache-2.0 license
keywords: chat with my own model from iphone
